name: flagship-foundry-cursor-companion
description: Cursor and VS Code companion for importing workspaces, ingesting knowledge, approving plans, and controlling agent runs.

flagshipFoundry.controlPlaneUrl.description: Base URL for the local Foundry control plane.

flagshipFoundry.autoApproveDraftPlans.description: Create plans with auto approval enabled.

flagshipFoundry.autoStartApprovedPlans.description: Automatically start a run after approval when supported.

flagshipFoundry.knowledgeManifestPath.description: Manifest used when ingesting seed documentation into the Foundry knowledge base.

flagshipFoundry.defaultFocusQuery.description: Default query used for generating a focused blast-radius view.

flagshipFoundry.foundryRoot.description: Absolute path to flagship-foundry-work (the repo root that contains apps/control-plane). Leave empty to auto-detect from the workspace (nested flagship-foundry-work/ or current folder).

flagshipFoundry.runExecutionMode.description: When starting a run from the overlay: simulate (dry) or execute (local-shell adapter in the control plane).

flagshipFoundry.customThemeUrl.description: Optional absolute URL for a browser pop-out theme stylesheet loaded after the built-in loopback theme.
